title: The Drowned Crown
premise: Casper Sterling has survived the Thornfell mountains by being forgettable: a smuggler, a beast-speaker, a woman whose forbidden gift lets her hear what animals know but never say. When a dying courier presses a bloodstained map into her hands and begs her to 'return what was sold,' she learns the map leads to the court beneath the mountain, where the usurper King Vaelric keeps a stolen soul—the soul of the drowned queen, and the key to the old magic that binds the free cities together. Hunted by Vaelric's inquisitors and shadowed by an unlikely found family—a disgraced knight, a debt-ridden cartographer, and a fox who is more than a fox—Casper must cross the drowned roads of the old kingdom to reach the court before Vaelric's armies march on the free cities at spring thaw. In the flooded throne room, Casper discovers the dying stranger was her grandfather, that the sold soul is her own inheritance, and that returning it means surrendering the memories that made her who she is. She gives up her past to give the queen back her name, breaks Vaelric's claim on the mountain, and returns to the surface with no memory of her journey—only a family that refuses to let her be forgotten.
about_author: Marguerite Delacroix is the pen name of a former river guide who spent a decade leading expeditions through remote mountain passes before turning to fiction full-time. Her work blends folklore, treacherous landscapes, and characters who find family in the unlikeliest company.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Silence
chapters.summary: POV Casper. On a frozen smuggling run through Thornfell, Casper negotiates passage with a suspiciously talkative marmot while dodging a royal patrol, establishing her gift, her rules (never be remembered), and her precarious independence. Emotional beat: wary contentment built on deliberate isolation.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Ford
chapters.summary: POV Casper. A dying man collapses at the river ford, pressing a bloodstained map into Casper's hands and whispering 'return what was sold' before the cold takes him. Royal inquisitors arrive searching for him; Casper flees with the map she never wanted. Emotional beat: guilt and dread as invisibility shatters.

chapters.title: What the Crows Knew
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Interrogating crows and a half-mad goat, Casper deciphers fragments of the map: the court beneath the mountain, a soul held in pledge, the usurper's seal. The fox that has followed her for weeks speaks its first word: 'Inheritance.' Emotional beat: reluctant curiosity overtaking fear.

chapters.title: The Knight Without a Banner
chapters.summary: POV Ser Aldric Vane. A disgraced knight hunting the same map corners Casper in a waystation; instead of killing her, he offers alliance—he served the drowned queen and wants his honor's debt paid. Emotional beat: two guarded people recognizing a shared wound.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Debt
chapters.summary: POV Odile Marchand. Odile, a cartographer indentured to Vaelric's guild, recognizes the map's watermark as her master's work and blackmails her way into the party to erase her complicity. Emotional beat: shame disguised as ambition, cracking at the edges.

chapters.title: Roads That Drown
chapters.summary: POV Casper. The trio enters the sunken causeways of the old kingdom, where the beasts speak in chorus and warn of the inquisitor Wren Halloway closing behind them. First ambush; Aldric is wounded protecting Casper. Emotional beat: the group becoming a unit under fire.

chapters.title: Holloway
chapters.summary: POV Wren Halloway. The inquisitor's chapters reveal Vaelric's plan: the stolen queen-soul powers the binding that will let his armies cross the thaw-floods into the free cities. Wren, once kind, now believes utterly. Emotional beat: chilling conviction, sympathy twisted into menace.

chapters.title: The Fox's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Trapped in a cave-in, Casper bargains with the fox—who names itself Ashen, a spirit bound to the drowned queen—for safe passage in exchange for a promise not yet named. Emotional beat: trust extended blindly, terror and wonder entwined.

chapters.title: Salt and Snowmelt
chapters.summary: POV Odile. Sheltering in a drowned chapel, Odile confesses she mapped Vaelric's prison routes; Aldric forgives her, and Casper realizes she has stopped planning to abandon them. Emotional beat: confession, forgiveness, the first true warmth of found family.

chapters.title: The Free Cities Burn Their Beacons
chapters.summary: POV Aldric. News reaches them: the free cities, believing the queen dead forever, are dousing their protective beacons in despair. The stakes crystallize—reach the court before the last beacon dies. Emotional beat: urgency hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Wolves at the Weir
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Halloway's riders trap them at a mountain weir; Casper unleashes her gift fully for the first time, turning the wolves of Thornfell against soldiers. The cost: the beasts now know her name, and names travel underground. Emotional beat: power and exposure in equal measure.

chapters.title: The Map's True Face
chapters.summary: POV Odile. Under moonlight, Odile discovers the map is drawn in the stranger's blood—and bears Casper's family crest. The dying man was her grandfather; the soul sold to the court may be hers by blood. Emotional beat: identity upended, inheritance revealed as burden.

chapters.title: Ashen's History
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Ashen shows Casper visions of the drowned queen's reign and the night Vaelric bought her soul from desperate loyalists—including Casper's grandfather, who spent his life trying to buy it back. Emotional beat: grief for a family she never knew, love arriving posthumously.

chapters.title: The Gate of Teeth
chapters.summary: POV Aldric. They reach the mountain's gate, guarded by constructs that test each traveler's worst memory. Aldric sacrifices his memory of the battle that disgraced him to hold the gate open. Emotional beat: sacrifice freely given, honor reclaimed.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Beneath the mountain: a court of pale courtiers who traded their souls piecemeal for safety, singing Vaelric's praises in hollow harmony. Casper sees her possible future in them. Emotional beat: horror of comfortable surrender.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Offer
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Vaelric, courteous and terrible, offers Casper her grandfather's debt forgiven and her gift legitimized if she surrenders the map and her claim. He reveals the soul in the vault answers to her blood alone. Emotional beat: temptation sharpened by loneliness.

chapters.title: Halloway's Doubt
chapters.summary: POV Wren Halloway. Confronted by Aldric with proof Vaelric murdered the queen's heirs—children Halloway swore to protect—her faith fractures. She turns her blade aside at the crucial moment, buying the others time. Emotional beat: conviction breaking, redemption costly.

chapters.title: The Vault of Names
chapters.summary: POV Casper. In the vault, Casper finds the queen's soul kept as a crown of water and light—and learns returning it requires a soul of equal weight: her own memories. Ashen reveals this was the unnamed promise. Emotional beat: the price made flesh, courage chosen anyway.

chapters.title: The Drowned Crown
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Climax. Casper pours her memories into the crown, restoring the queen just as Vaelric arrives; the risen queen unmakes his binding, the flood-waters turn on his armies, and Halloway holds the door. Casper's past burns away mid-embrace with her family. Emotional beat: triumph purchased with selfhood.

chapters.title: Aftermath of Water
chapters.summary: POV Odile. The court beneath the mountain empties as freed souls ascend; Odile maps the new passages so none are ever lost there again. The queen, whole, thanks three strangers for a stranger's promise. Emotional beat: exhausted tenderness, grief without regret.

chapters.title: The Name I Gave Away
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Awake in a free-city infirmary, Casper remembers nothing of the journey—but Aldric, Odile, and Ashen refuse to let her story vanish, retelling it until pieces root like grafts. Emotional beat: memory rebuilt through love rather than magic.

chapters.title: Beacons Rekindled
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Spring: the free cities relight their beacons, the queen takes a mortal stewardship of Thornfell, and Casper—smuggler no longer, beast-speaker still—walks an open road with her family beside her. Emotional beat: belonging chosen freely, the road ahead bright.
